requirement: How should I design an IoT application architecture?
option_text:
OPTION 1: Event-Driven Serverless IoT (Simple)
RECOMMENDED for getting started
Best for: Small to medium IoT deployments (up to 10,000 devices) with straightforward data flows
Cost: $50-300/month (depending on device count and message volume)

Key points:
- AWS IoT Core receives device messages over MQTT/HTTPS and handles authentication via device certificates
- IoT Rules Engine routes messages directly to Lambda functions for processing (no streaming layer needed)
- Lambda processes telemetry data, applies business logic, and writes to DynamoDB for current state
- DynamoDB stores device state and metadata with on-demand billing (pay per request)
- S3 stores historical data with lifecycle policies to move to Glacier after 90 days
- CloudWatch monitors Lambda errors and IoT metrics
- No VPC needed initially, but you can add VPC for Lambda if connecting to on-premises systems
- Compliance: Meets SOC 2 CC6.1, CC6.6, CC6.7 with encryption at rest/transit and CloudWatch Logs encrypted
- Your environment needs: Enable CloudTrail for audit logging and GuardDuty for threat detection

Tradeoffs: Simple architecture but less suited for high-throughput real-time analytics or complex event processing across multiple devices
